see_for_yourself.expected: The organizer sees Cellist's Yes and No, Pianist's Maybe and who hasn't answered; Cellist's Yes is still there after confirming; members see totals only.
steps: cd project && corepack pnpm run dev --host
Create a group and join it as Cellist and Pianist in two private windows
As organizer propose a weekly Thursday rehearsal starting next week
As Cellist answer Yes for the first date while it is still proposed, then confirm it as organizer
As Cellist answer No for the second date; as Pianist answer Maybe for every date
see_for_yourself.title: Two members answer differently

what_just_landed.detail: Members answer Yes, No or Maybe for each date of a proposed or confirmed rehearsal, change or clear it, or answer every date in the coming eight weeks at once.
